hero.title: One tap. Your Google review page opens.
hero.lead: A customer holds their phone to the card and lands straight on your review page. No app, no searching.
hero.sceneAlt: An NFC card moves towards a phone, and a five-star review page opens on the screen.

steps.title: We set it up
steps.text: Send us your business’s Google Maps link. We program the card so it opens your review page.

steps.title: You place it
steps.text: Put the card by the till, on a table or at reception — anywhere your customers will see it.

steps.title: Customers tap
steps.text: They hold their phone to the card, the review page opens, and they leave a rating in seconds.

items.title: Delivery across Uzbekistan
items.text: From Tashkent to any region. Order on Telegram and we send it to your city.

items.q: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
items.a: Yes. It works on iPhone XS and newer, and on Android phones with NFC switched on. That covers most phones in use today.

items.q: Does the customer need an app?
items.a: No. The phone reads the card by itself and opens the page in the browser or in Google Maps.
It depends on your city. Message us on Telegram and we’ll give you the exact timing before you order.

items.q: Can the link be changed later?
items.a: Yes. If your link changes, message us and we’ll help you update the card.
